items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to consecrate all firstborn of Israel to himself
items.object: all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast
